set.body:
Problem: DerivedEvents has no main-code consumer outside its own file (DerivedEvents.scala; only DerivedEventsSuite uses it), so callers must materialize derived columns before building. encodeDerivedColumns (ModelJsonCodec.scala:63) drops the DerivedMissingRows policy (DerivedEvents.scala:10, :93), so a saved model cannot reproduce which rows were dropped.

Consumer need: studio terms defined by expressions and bins (cut/cut_quantiles, is.na flags) with an explicit n/a policy (spec invariant I3; G38, G42).

Acceptance:
- EventDesignRequest and ModelBuildSpec accept derived declarations plus the missing-row policy.
- Dropped rows are recorded in the build audit with provenance.
- The policy round-trips through JSON; build from declarations equals build from manual materialization (JVM+JS).

Out of scope: new expression functions.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 against ScalaFIM main ea6fe3ad for the PLS Neuro model studio (plsneuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F; spec docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and GRAMMAR-NEEDS.md on plsneuro main).
set.title: Accept derived-event declarations and their missing-row policy as build input
